note: Courses this product has already published to customers, as of the release named below. An export may add to this list freely — publishing is gated elsewhere. Removing a course is unpublishing: it takes a course away from people who can already see it, so it must be a deliberate edit of this file, not a side effect of a re-export. Marking a course stale on disk is an authoring state, not a decision to unpublish it. Run check-published-catalog.mjs --accept-removals to record a removal you actually mean.
